name: Monitor competitor Google ads daily with Apify, Google Sheets, Slack and Gmail

parameters.content:
## Monitor competitor Google ads daily

### Who it's for
Marketing, PPC and brand teams who want to know when a competitor starts new Google ads.

### How it works
1. A Schedule Trigger fires once a day and reads your values from the Workflow settings node.
2. The Apify node runs the [Google Ads Transparency Center Scraper](https://apify.com/orbots/google-ads-transparency-scraper) Actor for your competitors and returns the dataset items. `onlyNew: true` returns only ads never delivered before: no repeats, no double charge.
3. Every new ad is appended to a Google Sheet (advertiser, creative ID, format, dates, links).
4. A Code node groups the new ads by advertiser and posts one digest to Slack. Nothing new, no message.
5. If one advertiser crosses your launch threshold (default 10 ads first shown in 7 days), Gmail also emails you.
6. An error branch posts to Slack if a run fails.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Install the verified Apify community node (`@apify/n8n-nodes-apify`) and connect your account
- [ ] In Workflow settings, list your competitors (domains work best) and the regions
- [ ] Pick the spreadsheet and sheet in the Google Sheets node
- [ ] Pick the channel in the two Slack nodes
- [ ] Set "emailTo" for launch alerts (empty turns the email off)

### Cost
Pay-per-event: $0.005 per run plus $0.0015 per ad on the free Apify plan (100 ads = about $0.16). The first run builds the baseline, an empty run is free, and each run is capped at $1.

*Google, Google Ads and Ads Transparency Center are trademarks of Google LLC. This template and the underlying Actor are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google LLC.*

## 1. Fetch new competitor ads
The Workflow settings node holds everything you edit: competitors, regions, cap per competitor, launch window and threshold, alert email. The Apify node builds its Actor input from those values, asks only for ads not delivered before and caps each run at 1 USD.

## 2. Keep the history
Every new ad becomes one row in Google Sheets. Columns map automatically from the item fields (advertiser, domain, creative ID, format, dates, days shown, links). On days with nothing new, no rows are appended and the run is free.

## 3. Digest and alerts
One Slack message per run: the new ads grouped by advertiser, with formats and links. If one advertiser crosses the launch threshold (ads first shown in the last days), Gmail sends an extra alert. Quiet days send nothing and cost nothing.

## 4. If a run fails
Optional: in the workflow settings, pick this workflow as its own error workflow. A failed run then posts the error message and the execution link to Slack.
